text:
Aisha: Quick one — we need to lock scope and acceptance criteria for the curated partner slate before outreach starts next week. Can we do a quick async triage here?
Sam: +1. main constraints: 1) 10 partner slots, 2) 4-week pilot window, 3) 2 technical integrations max.
Neil: Important to call out quant metrics vs qualitative. I propose: latency SLO adherence, error rate <1%, and 3 product feature asks validated.
Tara: For recruitment messaging, we should highlight 'early influence on roadmap' and 'priority support' — that drives higher commitment.
Josh: Capacity note — infra can support 10 partners if they stagger start by 1 week. If all start same day we risk queueing.
Aisha: Good call. Let's make stagger part of offer. Also need a simple acceptance checklist for partners. Draft: 
CS-bot: (automated) linking previous onboarding checklist: https://redwood.example/onboard-checklist
Priya: Draft acceptance checklist looks good. Add a privacy clause for customers wanting private deployment testing.
Aisha: Proposed acceptance checklist (short):
- Signed pilot agreement (PM + Legal)
- Two kickoff sessions scheduled (product + engineering)
- Success metrics agreed (quant + 2 qualitative prompts)
- Contact for weekly 30m syncs
- Data handling/KMS confirmed
Tara: Suggest we require partners to share 5 representative prompts + baseline outputs before starting so we can measure regressions.
Sam: Agree. Also set a guardrail: if model regression >5% on primary prompts we trigger rollback.
Neil: On evaluation cadence: weekly aggregate dashboard + a short mid-pilot eval at 2 weeks. Use both automatic diffs and human review.
Josh: Ops action: I'll expose a per-partner route with token-level cost breakdown and a small throttling policy we can tweak.
Priya: Outreach copy suggestion (one-liner): "Participate in a 4-week pilot to shape Redwood inference defaults for production — priority integration support provided."
Aisha: Nice. Can someone paste a quick email snippet?
Tara: "Hi <PartnerName>, we'd love your team's input on a short pilot to validate model serving at scale. Pilot includes 4 weeks of prioritized support, joint success metrics, and early access to batching/caching tuning. Interested?"
Sam: Logistics: who owns partner scoring? I can run a simple rubric (impact, technical fit, data availability, legal friction).
Aisha: Sam pls own scoring. Tara pls own outreach copy + CS handoff. Josh pls own capacity calendar. Neil pls own eval dashboard config. Priya pls own legal/data clause. I'll coordinate invites and the first kickoff template.
CS-bot: (reminder) create calendar stub: /create-pilot-kickoff <partner>
Priya: One more ask — add a clause allowing us to anonymize examples used in public evals unless partner opts out.
Aisha: Agreed. Okay team — asynchronous decision: if no objections by EOD tomorrow, we'll publish the invite list and start outreach Monday. :thumbsup:
Josh: No objections from infra.
Tara: Fine from comms.
Neil: Fine from ML.
Sam: Fine from product scoring perspective.
Priya: Fine from legal.
Aisha: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the final invite list here once scoring is done.
